note: 'bearing fruit' (Col 1:10), and the same pairing inverted at Titus 3:14, 'that they be not unfruitful'. The two words stand in one phrase, which they do nowhere in Galatians or Ephesians.
'bearing fruit in every good work' (Col 1:10); 'devote themselves to good works in order to meet the pressing needs of others, so that they will not be unfruitful' (Titus 3:14).
'bearing fruit for death' (Rom 7:5). The figure carries either way; here what is borne is death.
'For when we were in the flesh ... worked in our members to bring out fruit to death' (Rom 7:5).
Said by Paul at Col 1:10; the letter names him at Col 1:1.
Said by Paul at Rom 7:5; the letter names him at Rom 1:1.
